import math
# Axis is world X; the wide face is the negative-X end.
head=cq.Solid.makeCone(30,17,27,cq.Vector(0,0,0),cq.Vector(1,0,0))
collar=cq.Solid.makeCylinder(17,3,cq.Vector(27,0,0),cq.Vector(1,0,0))
shaft=cq.Workplane("YZ",origin=(30,0,0)).circle(15).extrude(40)
# Sixteen straight V flutes.
for i in range(16):
    a=2*math.pi*i/16
    pts=[]
    for r,t in [(13.3,a),(17,a-0.11),(17,a+0.11)]:
        pts.append((r*math.cos(t),r*math.sin(t)))
    tool=cq.Workplane("YZ",origin=(30,0,0)).polyline(pts).close().extrude(40)
    shaft=shaft.cut(tool)
part=cq.Workplane(obj=head).union(collar).union(shaft)
bore=cq.Solid.makeCylinder(12.5,20,cq.Vector(0,0,0),cq.Vector(1,0,0))
result=part.cut(bore)
